what_this_is: Every [MEASURED IN BRIEF] number in lane A2, with its source file, byte count and controls, so each can be re-run. No number here is from a summariser.

endpoint.folder_listing_method: parsed the folder page's window['_DRIVE_ivd'] blob; method taken from the openassetpricing package's own gdrive_parse.py

files.name: DailyPortfolios/Predictor.zip
files.note: uc?export=download returned HTTP 200 with a 2,430-byte text/html virus-scan-warning page; real bytes required drive.usercontent.google.com/download?...&confirm=t

C3_pipeline_vs_published.source_of_published: Chen & Welch 2026 (arXiv 2607.06502) abstract, read in full

C6_daily_vs_monthly_reconciliation.rule: 21 x mean daily long-short must reproduce the monthly long-short from a different file
C6_daily_vs_monthly_reconciliation.note: BM's ratio is meaningless: its monthly return is ~0 so the division is by ~zero

C7_positive_control_on_resolution.rule: the method must DETECT non-uniform accrual where it is known to exist, else 'uniform' is a lack of resolution rather than a finding

C2_second_implementation.rule: long-short recomputed as highest-bin minus lowest-bin from the component bins, never reading the files' own LS port, then compared

C4_published_qualitative_result.rule: Chen & Zimmermann report the $5 price screen is the SOFTEST liquidity adjustment; the ordering must come back
C4_published_qualitative_result.verdict: ordering confirmed; but both screens cost about a quarter of the median premium

C5_a_control_that_failed.verdict: a screen that multiplies a premium by 3.4x means the screened and unscreened objects are not the same strategy; both are NAMED and NEITHER is used

alt_ports_2010_2024.units: percent per month, long-short = highest bin minus lowest bin
alt_ports_2010_2024.note: group medians and per-signal values are reproduced in the brief's tables; the full per-signal dict is under 'per_signal' keyed construction -> signal -> [mean, t, n_months]

leg_decomposition_and_luck_shrinkage.method: long leg minus the NAME-WEIGHTED average of every bin in the SAME sort (not the CRSP value-weighted market). Shrinkage is Chen & Welch's r_adj = [1-1/Var(t)]*r with Var(t) taken from MY OWN 209-signal cross-section in that construction, truncated at zero.

daily_accrual_2010_2024.method: daily portLS series bucketed by ORDINAL TRADING DAY WITHIN THE CALENDAR MONTH; close-to-close daily returns, so this says NOTHING about the overnight session

cost_arithmetic.assumption: programme's own measured 33.8 bp/side -> 67.6 bp round trip, plus 2 x 50/P commission; P = $10 gives 77.6 bp per round trip
